name: GitHub issue triage
description: Prioritize open issues and establish acceptance criteria before marking them ready for development.
exampleImplementation: Run a lightweight GitHub scanner on a schedule. When an issue changes, the scanner delegates that issue to an agent with the selected profile; only the agent receives a conversation runtime.

schedule.label: Check frequency
schedule.help: How often to check repository progress.

repositories.label: Repositories
repositories.help: Repositories this automation may work on.

githubTokenSecret.label: GitHub token secret
githubTokenSecret.help: Name of a saved secret allowed by the selected agent profile. Enter its name, not its value.

setup.message: Configure the repositories, credential name, agent profile, and schedule.
